## Overview

- Nov 17 (Tuesday): asynchronous lecture
- Nov 19 (Thursday): in-person lecture, **quiz 8**


## Tuesday, Nov 17 (asynchronous)

Study **one sample t-test** and **confidence intervals** from [Chapter 11](../../course_documents/all_lectures/chapter_11_slide.html).  Your end goal is to be able to do the questions similar to the four examples at the end of the slides.  For the quiz on Thursday, you can expect a question similar to these.

I have recorded the following videos to cover some conceptual discussions that happen before the examples.  Please watch them, but pause often so you can try out the procedures and examples yourself.  

- [Chapter 11 slides](https://youtu.be/6NcaTZn0FyI)
- [Confidence interval and hypothesis testing](https://youtu.be/RZJWNLt6juo)

It is ok if there are concepts related to inferential statistics and p-values that you do not fully understand for now.  We will go back to these concepts thoughout this chapter.  You should still be able to carry out a one-sample t-test and do the example questions.  You can find more examples in the [Chapter 11 homework](../../course_documents/homework/chapter_11.qmd).


## Thursday, Nov 19 (in-person)

Quiz question will be similar to the one-sample t-test examples at the end of [Chapter 11](../../course_documents/all_lectures/chapter_11_slide.html) slides.  

In class, we will finish [Chapter 8](../../course_documents/all_lectures/chapter_8_slide.html) and [Chapter 9](../../course_documents/all_lectures/Chapter_9_slide.html).
